lines.en: "You should explain the umbrella episode that you..." Ohh!
lines.ja: 「傘の話を聞きたい」って？

lines.en: There's something about... Oh, I did... I lost my umbrella the other day as well.
lines.ja: この前も傘を失くしちゃったんだよ

lines.en: Not lost, I gave my umbrella away. Um...
lines.ja: 「失くした」じゃなくて「あげた」だけどね

lines.en: I was walking to the station, okay?
lines.ja: 駅に向かって歩いてたんだけど

lines.en: It was also pouring rain.
lines.ja: その日はスッゴイ雨が降っててね

lines.en: Like, pouring! Like, actually pouring.
lines.ja: もう土砂降り！

lines.en: So... I was walking to the station, when I saw a child...
lines.ja: 駅に向かってたら…子供がいたんだ

lines.en: And I think they were coming home from school.
lines.ja: 学校帰りって感じの子

lines.en: They had, like... All of their hands were, like, full.
lines.ja: 荷物で両手がふさがってて

lines.en: The backpack, soccer ball in hand... Like, bags on bags on bags.
lines.ja: リュック持ってサッカーボール抱えて とにかく大荷物だった

lines.en: And, like... And then, the kid was about to walk back out into the rain.
lines.ja: そんな子が雨の中 歩いて帰ろうとしてたから

lines.en: So, I gave them my umbrella.
lines.ja: ボクの傘をあげたんだ

lines.en: But I kind of walked up, and I was like, "Oh, are you okay?"
lines.ja: 「大丈夫？」って声はかけたけど

lines.en: I didn't really wait for a response... because I was immediately then pounded by the rain.
lines.ja: 自分が濡れちゃうから 返事を聞いてるヒマもなくてさ

lines.en: But it's fine. 'Cuz the station was really close by.
lines.ja: 駅は近かったし

lines.en: I was gonna run, and I could just be under cover, and it's fine. So, like...
lines.ja: 走ればいいやと思って そうしたんだけど…

notes.meaning: 屋根の下・雨よけの場所にいる、の意味

lines.en: No, no, no, no, no, hold on!
lines.ja: ……いやいや待てよ？

notes.meaning: 待って、ちょっと待って

lines.en: Hold on!
lines.ja: ちょっと待った！

lines.en: I gave this kid an umbrella when...
lines.ja: 傘をあげたのはいいけど…

lines.en: he was already carrying 20 million things!
lines.ja: あの子は山盛りの荷物で 手がいっぱいだったんだよ！？

notes.meaning: 「ものすごくたくさんの物」を誇張して言う言い方

lines.en: I don't know if it was a good thing!
lines.ja: 逆に迷惑だったかなぁ！？

lines.en: I think the kid said, "Thank you."
lines.ja: 「ありがとう」って言ってたと思うけど

lines.en: I think he was very confused.
lines.ja: 戸惑っただろうな…

lines.en: "Mysterious umbrella lady!"
lines.ja: 「謎の傘女現る」ってね…

lines.en: "Who needs an umbrella? I got you!"
lines.ja: ボクの傘を使いなさ～い！
